resale_co.name: Residential Certificate of Compliance
resale_co.issued_by: Township of East Hanover Land Use & Construction Departments (Enforcement Officer), after the Fire Prevention Bureau certifies smoke and CO detectors
resale_co.valid_for: Expires 6 months from the approved date.
requirements: Certificate of Compliance application signed by the property owner (resale or rental/lease; single family, two-family, or single family with business use; list any past variances)
Separate Smoke Detector/Carbon Monoxide/Fire Extinguisher application and separate check to the Fire Prevention Bureau
Inspection by the Enforcement Officer for violations of Township codes and ordinances; violations must be corrected and reinspected (extra fee if more than one reinspection)
Fire Prevention Bureau documentation of smoke and carbon monoxide detectors must be presented before the certificate is issued

fees.label: Residential Certificate of Compliance (resale or rental/lease)
fees.quote: Please make checks or money order payable to the Township of East Hanover in the amount of $100 total for Certificate of Compliance.

fees.label: Certificate of continued use or occupancy, residential (Township code fee schedule, Chapter 79)
fees.quote: Certificate of continued use or occupancy (residential): $75.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Mail or drop off the Residential Certificate of Compliance packet at the Land Use & Construction Departments, 411 Ridgedale Avenue, East Hanover, NJ 07936: the Certificate of Compliance application with a $100 check or money order payable to the Township of East Hanover, plus the Smoke Detector/CO/Fire Extinguisher application with a separate check (memo: Fire Prevention Bureau). Questions: 973-888-6025.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official / Building Inspector and Zoning Official

evidence.quote: In accordance with East Hanover Township Ordinance 119-A-5 and 26-36A(9), any real property containing a building must secure a Certificate of Compliance before sale, lease or rental of said property.
Applications and checks can be mailed or dropped off at the above address.

On and after the date of adoption of this chapter, it shall be a violation to sell or lease any real property containing a building unless the owner of the same has secured a certificate of compliance.

When the premises is found to be violation free and upon presentation by the owner of documentation from the Fire Prevention Bureau certifying the presence of smoke-sensitive and carbon monoxide detectors, a certificate of compliance shall be issued.

resale_co.notes: Township code Chapter 119A (Property Maintenance), Section 119A-5, read through the ecode360 print view, makes it a violation to sell or lease a building without a certificate of compliance; Section 119A-8 also bars selling property with uncorrected noticed violations without the Enforcement Officer's approval. The form (Rev. 06-12-25) charges $100; the Chapter 79 fee schedule still lists $75 for a residential certificate of continued use or occupancy. The packet gives the office phone 973-888-6025 (fax 973-428-3026); the Construction Department page lists 973-428-3026 as the Construction Office number. A certificate of compliance is not required for refinancing. Landlord registration is a rental-only item.

requirements: Smoke detectors on every level (basement, first floor, second floor; not crawl spaces or unfinished attics) and in every separate sleeping area; basement detector near the bottom of the stairs

Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units (UL 217); hardwired alarms from original construction cannot be replaced with battery units; homes built in or after 1991 need hardwired interconnected alarms with battery backup inside and outside bedrooms and on each level
Carbon monoxide alarm near the sleeping areas in homes with a fuel-burning device or attached garage (battery, hardwired or plug-in, UL 2034)

ABC fire extinguisher, no larger than 10 lbs, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, top no more than 5 feet up, new or tagged by a licensed contractor, with owner's manual (Township form and code still list it)

authorities.name: East Hanover Fire Department, Bureau of Fire Prevention
authorities.lead_time: Fee is based on business days before the change of occupant: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. If the change of occupancy does not happen within 6 months, a new application is needed.

fees.label: Smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate, application more than 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Application received more than ten (10) business days before a change of occupant, and the fee shall be one hundred dollars ($100.00).

fees.label: Application 4 to 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Application received four (4) to ten (10) business days before a change of occupant, the fee shall be one hundred and twenty-five dollars ($125.00).

fees.label: Application less than 4 days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Application received less than four (4) days before a change of occupant, and the fee shall be one hundred and fifty dollars ($150.00).

fees.label: Request for certification on the same day as the settlement
fees.quote: Application received for same day as the settlement; the fee shall be two hundred dollars ($200.00).

fees.label: Re-inspection (missing/outdated/non-working equipment, no one present, or cancellation under 24 hours)
fees.quote: less than twenty-four (24) hours, the fee shall be fifty dollars ($50.00).

authorities.how_to_apply: Submit the Application for Certification of Smoke Detector, Carbon Monoxide Alarm & Portable Fire Extinguisher Compliance (part of the Residential Certificate of Compliance packet) with a separate check or money order payable to Township of East Hanover, memo 'Fire Prevention Bureau'. The certificate is non-transferable and the fee is not refundable.

evidence.quote: FEE: CSACMAPFEC (Smoke Alarm Inspection) shall be based upon the amount of time before the change of occupant is expected, as per the following: § 26-36A(9)
If the change of occupancy does not occur within 6 months, a new application is required.
Request for certification on the same day as the settlement; the fee shall be $200.
LEAID: 1410-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official James Cavezza Phone (973) 887-6854 Addr: 323 Ridgedale Ave - PO Box 34 East Hanover NJ 07936 ... Email jamesc@easthanovertownship.com

fire_cert.notes: Fees are tiered by business days before the change of occupant (Township code Section 26-36A(9) and the June 2025 form). The Township form and code still require a portable fire extinguisher, which the state dropped from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19); confirm with the Bureau. Phone and email are from the NJ DCA fire directory; the Township fire page lists names only. Code Section 26-36A(10) also lists a $50 certificate of fire code status for a CO, CH or CA, which is for construction certificates, not resales.

other_items.label: Uncorrected violations
other_items.detail: Selling property with uncorrected violations that the owner was notified of requires the Enforcement Officer's prior approval (Township code 119A-8).

other_items.label: Water and sewer account
other_items.detail: A new water/sewer service application must be made and approved by the Township on any change in ownership when the owner is the customer (Township code 159-75).
